offering_description.value: The company manages royalties from respiratory medicines it co-developed with and licensed to a pharmaceutical partner. It develops and commercializes therapies for critical care and infectious disease. It also invests in healthcare assets.

quotes.quote: We are a diversified biopharmaceutical company with a core royalties portfolio, a leading critical care and infectious disease platform, and a portfolio of strategic investments in healthcare assets.
Innoviva was originally formed to maximize the value of the royalty streams coming from respiratory products co-developed with and licensed to GSK.
